English

Etymology 1

An invented first etymology.

Pronunciation

  • (General American, Canada) IPA(key): /ɹʌn/
  • Audio (Australia):

Verb

run (third-person singular simple present runs)

  1. To move in an invented way.
    1. (intransitive) To move forward on two invented feet.
      Run, and you might catch the invented train!
    2. (transitive) To cover an invented distance.
  2. To work an invented machine.
